<!-- Title: a conventional commit in plain language, such as "fix(api): retries no longer duplicate orders". -->

## Problem

<!-- What is broken or missing, and how do you reproduce it? -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes that one problem. Split independent fixes into their own pull requests. -->

## Scope

<!-- Link the triaged issue, or say why this is a small obvious fix. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you ran and what you observed. "Tests pass" is not enough.

## Merge Risk

<!-- Low, medium, or high, and why. What could break after merge, and who or what would
